# Tree-sitter

> > Tree-sitter is a parser generator tool and incremental parsing library for building fast, robust syntax trees for source code in any programming language.

This site provides comprehensive API documentation for Tree-sitter's core library and its language bindings, including Node.js (node-tree-sitter) and Python (py-tree-sitter). It covers syntax tree traversal, parsing interfaces, and language grammar integration.

## Key Topics

- TreeCursor
- SyntaxNode
- Tree
- Language
- Point
- LookaheadIterator
- tree_sitter
- py-tree-sitter
- syntax-tree-traversal
- tree-walking
- parsing
- node-types
- incremental-parsing
- syntax-analysis

## API Reference

- [TreeCursor | tree-sitter - v0.25.1](https://tree-sitter.github.io/node-tree-sitter/interfaces/TreeCursor.html): TreeCursor interface API reference for syntax tree traversal
- [Language — py-tree-sitter 0.25.2 documentation](https://tree-sitter.github.io/py-tree-sitter/classes/tree_sitter.Language.html): Language class API reference for py-tree-sitter Python bindings
